_comment: LOCAL SMOKE - NOT RESULTS. The two Mac rehearsals of infra/gpu/bootstrap.sh run on 2026-10-07
before the rented-GPU session, in its rehearsal mode (WO5_LOCAL_SMOKE=1): the pod's command end
to end except the clone, the venv and the download, with the device (mps, then cpu), a 1% user
subsample (an 11,623-movie catalog instead of 34,461), 20 s budgets and 5 warm-up steps
overridden, each override recorded in every document. Written by a script from the two sessions'
summary.json and results/*.json, verbatim. They prove the path, and give the session a sanity
reference for its step times; they are not the full-data timings the cells files describe and
are cited nowhere as a measurement. Commit e9d9c2e. The mps session was recorded in the shared
MLflow store as a tagged local-smoke run; its first record attempt created the run and failed
the read-back against the 2.13 server, and the fixed script's second pull verified that same run
